astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: The Ghosts of Five Supernovas
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: The ghosts of five supernovas haunt this extraordinary image.   It was acquired at Oukaïmeden Observatory in Morocco with approximately 200 hours of observations and shows a large patch of the sky, equivalent to the area of one thousand full moons tiled together, in the constellation of Auriga (the charioteer).   From left to right, the five supernova remnants visible across the field are G181.1+9…
